hypothesis: Point-in-time all-market capitalization concentration, breadth and concentration change measure internal leadership structure and add stable 20-trading-day TWII direction beyond index trend and aggregate FinMind positioning.
decision_time: After date-t cash close and publication of date-t TaiwanStockMarketValue.
target: TWII close direction from date t to 20 actual Taiwan cash-market trading days later.

data_semantics.point_in_time_universe: Four-digit common stocks with positive market value on that source date; no current constituent list.
data_semantics.raw_persistence: Raw security rows are reduced to one immutable daily aggregate row and are not retained.

features: causal 252-row z-score of active stock count
causal 252-row z-score of log total market capitalization
causal z-scores of top-1, top-5, top-10, top-20 and top-50 capitalization shares
causal z-score of bottom-half capitalization share
causal z-scores of median log capitalization, log-cap IQR and q90-q10 spread
causal z-scores of 20-day top-10-share and HHI changes
feature_transform: Every transform uses only date-t and earlier observations, with a 252-row window and minimum 126 rows.
method: 1512/252/252 nested ridge-abstention, 20-row purge at fit/validation boundaries, frozen lambda and confidence threshold for each following test block, and effective origins separated by at least 20 actual TWII rows.
formal_run_policy: Execute exactly once after this manifest. No result-dependent feature, threshold, date, horizon, subgroup or baseline changes are allowed.
promotion_policy: The market-cap treatment must pass every absolute gate, significantly beat the strongest simple baseline on identical dates, and significantly beat the index/aggregate control on common dates. Otherwise every market-cap directional coefficient remains zero.
